Google Cloud’s VPC firewall and Ubuntu’s firewall are separate. The
setting from Step 4 permits HTTP through the cloud firewall.
If UFW is not installed, install it, then check its status:

sudo apt install -y ufw
sudo ufw status

sudo ufw allow 22/tcp
sudo ufw allow 80/tcp

, leave it inactive for this lab. Adding UFW rules alone does
